title: Users
purpose: Find staff and client accounts and review their assigned access.
summary: Find staff and client accounts and check their roles, client link and release authority. Only superusers can open this list.

tasks.title: Find an account
steps: Type a username, name or email in the search box and press Enter.
Narrow it with the filters on the right, such as account type or release authority.
Select the username to open the account.

tasks.title: Create an account
steps: Select [[Add user]] and fill in the account. No invitation email is sent.

good_to_know: Accounts are never deleted. Clear Active on the account instead, so its history keeps its name.
Roles shows the account's groups. The admin group also covers custodian, analyst, reviewer and project manager work, but not approver.
Can release needs the explicit release permission, directly or through a group. Superuser status does not give it.
A client-linked account cannot have staff flags, groups or permissions.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; a laboratory admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or report-release authority.

items.label: Username
items.description: Sign-in identifier and link to the user change form; sortable.

items.label: Name
items.description: Full first/last name or dash. Sorts by last name, not the displayed combined string.

items.label: Email address
items.description: Account authentication/recovery email, sortable; distinct from reporting contacts.

items.label: Roles
items.description: Assigned group names alphabetically, including custom groups; Client portal for a client-linked account, or None with no group. It is not an expanded list of admin’s effective operational roles and is not sortable.

items.label: Can release
items.description: Boolean for active internal accounts holding explicit authorize_release directly or through a group. Not sortable.

items.label: Client
items.description: Portal ownership client, or empty for internal staff; sortable.

items.label: Active / Superuser status
items.description: Enabled-account and technical superuser flags, both sortable. Staff status is not a column on this list.

items.label: Last login
items.description: Latest successful login time, or dash; sortable.

sections.title: Search, filters and paging
paragraphs: Search matches case-insensitive substrings. Space-separated terms must each match at least one configured field; quote a phrase to match it as one term. The result query includes all matches, not just visible rows. Clearing the search restores the unsearched set while preserving applicable filters.

These are Django administration tables, not operational grids. The server uses 100 records per page, with numbered page links and a total count. Show all appears when the filtered result count is at most 200 and exceeds one page. There is no Rows per page selector or Columns dialog. Linked sortable headings change order; repeated heading clicks change direction or remove that ordering. The sidebar navigation filter only filters module links, not table records.
Initial order is Username ascending. No row-selection checkboxes or bulk actions are shown because account actions are disabled.

items.label: Search
items.description: Username, first name, last name or email.

items.label: account type
items.description: Laboratory staff means no client link; it does not require Staff status. Client portal user means a client link.

items.label: release authority
items.description: Can release reports selects active internal users with the actual accounts authorize_release permission; Cannot release includes everyone else.

items.label: active / superuser status / groups / client
items.description: Standard boolean/group/client filters. Groups includes custom groups. All removes an individual restriction. Sidebar filters use links, with All restoring that filter. Show counts or Hide counts toggles per-option counts, and Clear all filters clears active sidebar restrictions. Filtering applies to all records and resets paging.

items.label: Add user
items.description: Opens account creation. No invitation is sent automatically. Existing users are deactivated rather than deleted.

sections.title: Role, preservation and edit rules
paragraphs: Client-linked users cannot have Staff status, Superuser status, any groups or direct permissions in the supported account forms. An active internal admin group grants custodian, analyst, reviewer and project-manager operations; approver is not implied. Release needs explicit accounts authorize_release; nobody reviews their own result work. User deletion is disabled. Forms prevent demoting/deactivating the last active superuser. User/group and administrator password changes have attributed audit events without password values.
